o.title: Settings
o.importHint: Excel, ODS or CSV. From Google Sheets: File › Download › Microsoft Excel. Kapi recognises months, categories, income, readings and bills.
o.impSafe: You can import again: existing rows are updated, not duplicated.
o.cloudHint: Connect Dropbox and/or Google Drive to sync your data across devices.
o.cloudPrivacy: 🔒 Kapibo has no server: data goes straight from your phone to your cloud.
o.dbxHint: You need a Dropbox app (free at dropbox.com/developers) with redirect URI {uri}.
o.gdHint: You need a Google OAuth Client ID (type “Web application”) with origin {origin}.
o.aiHint: With your own Claude API key, the text read from a receipt is tidied up by a small, cheap model. Photos stay on your phone.
o.aiHint2: The key stays on this device only.
o.wipeSure: Delete everything from this device? Your connected cloud isn't touched until you sync.
o.about: Home budget with Kapi. Free, no ads, your data stays yours.

gate.title: Welcome to Kapibo!
gate.intro: Before we start, here's in short how it works and how we handle your data.
gate.accept: I have read and accept the privacy policy and the terms of use
tour.welcome.p: Let me show you Kapibo in a few steps. You can skip anytime.
tour.news.p: Kapibo updated itself. I'll show you just the new things.
tour.summary.p: Spending, savings, income, meal vouchers and balances for the chosen month.
tour.add.p: Amount, category, done: it takes two seconds.
tour.meta.p: Salary, extra income, refunds, meal vouchers and opening and closing balance.
tour.monthNav.p: Use the arrows or tap the month name to pick another one.
tour.scan.p: Receipts, payslips, bank statements, bills and meters: snap a photo and check.
tour.usage.p: Meter readings, bills and offer comparison.
tour.stats.p: Monthly trends, categories and Kapi's tips for saving.
tour.import.p: Import Excel, ODS or CSV: months, categories, readings and bills.
tour.cloud.p: Connect Dropbox or Google Drive to have your data on every device.
tour.kapi.p: I comment on what you do and cheer you on. Tap me for a sweet phrase.
tour.jar.p: It fills up with this month's savings. Let's fill it together!
tour.themes.p: Joyful capybara, Onsen or Capybara night.
tour.stickers.p: Unlock stickers as you use Kapibo: collect them all!
tour.install.p: Add it to your Home screen: it opens like an app and works offline too.
tour.end.p: Kapibo updates itself and will show you what's new right here.
inst.title: Install Kapibo
inst.hint: Opens like an app, full screen, even offline.
inst.ios3: Tap “Add”: Kapi is waiting on your Home screen!
inst.none: Open Kapibo in Chrome, Edge or Safari to install it.
news.110: Capybara icons, themes, Kapi cheering you on, collectible stickers, the yuzu jar, easy install, automatic updates and a what's-new tour.
news.111: New, more complete privacy notice and terms of use, with specific approval of the clauses.
